summary: Anonymous candidate T03/A remains faithful and reader-eligible after all 3 paragraphs were reviewed. No necessary repair was identified. Supplied unvalidated model outputs: Human 0.13351638%, AI 95.93549371%, AI-edited 0.01955606%, Humanized 3.91143411%. The recorded AI-involvement class score is 99.86648362%. The highest model class is ai. These are experimental class responses, not verified authorship probabilities, word shares, or prose-quality ratings. The installed skill reports high-confidence false positives in its English pilot. Retain the candidate; the measured response does not create a prose defect.

document_analysis.structure: P1 foregrounds the warning towel and retains the winter delay and inherited chair. P2 gives disassembly and uncertainty, with the patch before the memory gap. P3 states practical gain before the wished-for broader resolution and unresolved box. All source functions survive.
document_analysis.reasoning_specificity: The towel, kitchen corner, visitors, aunt, one careful pull, expected glue resistance, ambiguous patch, uneven floor, and wardrobe box all remain. The source's uncertainty and limited emotional claim are preserved; no tools, memories, feelings, or box contents are invented.
document_analysis.voice_consistency: The first-person voice remains understated and a little formal. Naming my aunt's things instead of her things clarifies the reference without changing emotional intensity. The source's refusal of closure is intact.
document_analysis.rhythm_repetition: Short opening and action sentences are mixed with longer reflective ones. The final sentence carries both the wish for resolution and the remaining choices. This is clear, though slightly denser than B's separated beats.
document_analysis.language_features: English is idiomatic. The semicolon joining inheritance and reluctance is legitimate. Repair or just where the finish wore off leaves both alternatives under might. I left the patch alone makes the original pronoun referent explicit.
document_analysis.citations_provenance: All experiences remain fictional. No authentic personal history or quotation is added. A readable anecdote is not human-authorship evidence; candidate method and scores are unknown. The supplied native result matches the exact candidate hash, pinned checkpoint, and one window covering all input tokens. Native model classification is separate from documented source history; method identity remains blind.

spans.quote: My warning system was a folded towel on the seat of a loose chair. The chair stayed in the corner of my kitchen for most of the winter. Visitors understood the warning, although I still explained the wobble every time someone came over. I had inherited the chair from my aunt; an awkward joint did not seem reason enough to throw it out.

findings.discriminating_evidence: Writing history would be needed to identify the editing process. The source-bound blind review is sufficient for this retain decision; no authorship conclusion is drawn from fluency.
